config.autoStageAllForDiff.desc: Only when the staging area is empty: temporarily stage all changes to build the diff, then restore your staging state. Use with caution—this may include unrelated changes in the prompt.
config.chain.enabled.desc: Enable multi-step chain prompting for commit generation (It makes the generated commit messages more detailed and accurate, and better aligns with the user's template, but it will increase latency and token consumption).
config.chain.maxParallel.desc: Maximum parallel LLM calls used by chain prompting across all providers. Increase carefully to avoid provider rate limits.
config.chain.contextWindowTokens.desc: Model context window used by Thinking mode. Defaults to 128k; built-in models are clamped to their registered limit. Change only for Custom endpoints. Input, output, and safety margins are allocated automatically.
config.chain.investigation.enabled.desc: Let the change-conditioned chain look up definitions, callers, callees, types, configuration, and tests for the changed symbols. Disabling this analyzes the change from the diff alone.
config.chain.investigation.maxSteps.desc: Maximum repository lookups the investigation agent may perform for one commit (minimum 3). Lower values reduce latency and token consumption; higher values allow deeper tracing of callers and dependencies.
config.chain.investigation.excludePatter: Additional file and directory patterns to exclude from repository investigation. Build outputs, dependency directories, and lockfiles are already excluded.
config.defaultThinkingLevel.desc: Global thinking level applied to every foreground and background model call for supported models; the default is `off`. Models without configurable thinking remain off. Custom OpenAI-compatible models inherit this setting automatically and require no per-model thinking setup. Only endpoints with non-standard Chat Completions parameters need Manage Models → Advanced thinking compatibility. Unsupported official levels fail instead of being rewritten.
config.modelThinkingLevels.desc: Optional per-model overrides. Each key is `provider/model`; each value is a thinking level. Example key and value: `openai/gpt-5.4` → `high`, or JSON `{ "openai/gpt-5.4": "high", "custom/Qwen3.5-9B": "low" }`. A missing key inherits `defaultThinkingLevel`. Once an execution starts, that model's resolved level is reused for every stage. Supported values are `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and `max`. Custom models may also use a provider-native non-empty string such as `VERY_HIGH`.
config.thinkingBudgets.desc: Token budgets used only by Anthropic/Google models with numeric thinking budgets and custom endpoints explicitly configured with an advanced local-engine budget field. Example: `{ "low": 4096, "medium": 10240 }`. Ordinary OpenAI-compatible provider models do not require this setting.
config.llm.maxRetries.desc: Maximum retries for recoverable model response validation failures, including Memory consolidation.
config.llm.temperature.desc: Temperature (0–2). Default 1. Some provider/model combinations only accept 1; changing this value may cause 400 errors (invalid temperature) or less stable outputs.
config.rag.enabled.desc: Enable RAG to keep commit message generation style consistent (requires a sufficient number of historical commit messages in the repository to build a local style index). Before enabling, configure the embedding API key via the [Git Commit Genie: Configure RAG Embedding API Key](command:git-commit-genie.configureRagEmbeddingApiKey) command.
config.rag.embedding.baseUrl.desc: Base URL for the embeddings API used by RAG. Must be compatible with the OpenAI SDK format.
config.rag.embedding.dimensions.desc: Optional embedding dimensions used by RAG.
config.rag.embedding.batchSize.desc: Batch size used when RAG generates embeddings.
config.commitLanguage.desc: Target language for generated commit messages.
config.typingAnimationSpeed.desc: Speed of the commit message box typing animation in milliseconds per character. Set to -1 to disable the animation.
config.showUsageCost.desc: When enabled, a brief notification will displays the estimated total cost for the current generation.
config.ui.stageNotifications.enabled.des: Show chain prompting progress in the VS Code status bar.
config.ui.rawData.enabled.desc: Show stage inputs, outputs, and tool results in the WebUI for debugging. Raw data can contain repository source code and model inputs; it is kept only for the current Extension Host session.
templates.chooseLocation: Choose where to save the template
templates.renameExists: A template with that name already exists.
config.memory.enabled.desc: Enable local navigation memory from actual investigations (off by default).
config.memory.consolidation.enabled.desc: Consolidate episodes with the generation model while idle; message delivery never waits for this work.
config.memory.consolidation.maxCallsPer2: Paid consolidation starts per clone in a rolling 24-hour window (positive integer). A started operation counts even if it fails or is cancelled. Validation-repair retries use Max retries and do not consume this allowance. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.maxStorageMiB.desc: Per-clone episode storage budget in MiB. Retention is enforced on the next publication, not immediately when Settings change. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.excludePatterns.desc: Additional path patterns excluded from recording, retrieval, and consolidation.
config.memory.navigation.maxTokens.desc: Navigation input budget in estimated tokens. Also limited by the input percentage. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.navigation.maxInputPercent: Maximum percentage of model input reserved for navigation (1–100). Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.search.maxCalls.desc: Additional Memory searches per generation; 0 disables additional searches. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.sources.maxChunks.desc: Unique Memory source validation attempts per generation. Invalid IDs do not consume this budget. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.sources.timeoutMs.desc: Timeout in milliseconds for each Memory source expansion call. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.sources.maxResultTokens.de: Maximum estimated tokens in a complete Memory tool result; oversized results are explicitly rejected. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.consolidation.maxInputToke: Consolidation input budget in estimated tokens, including prompt and schema; constrained by the model context. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.consolidation.maxOutputTok: Consolidation output token limit; constrained by the configured model output budget. Higher limits may increase API costs. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.storage.maxEpisodes.desc: Maximum retained episodes per clone; enforced on the next publication. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.storage.maxEpisodeKiB.desc: Maximum size in KiB for a newly published episode. Existing larger episodes remain readable. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
config.memory.storage.maxManifestMiB.des: Maximum newly published manifest size in MiB. Lowering this does not mark existing data as corrupt. Numeric budget changes apply to the next operation.
